name: Configure 6-Panel BCI Research Multi-Modal Dashboard
description:
You are a computational neuroscience graduate student setting up a multi-modal BCI monitoring dashboard for your lab's cognitive study. Before each participant session, you must configure OpenBCI GUI with the complete dashboard that your lab uses as standard.

The OpenBCI GUI is at the System Control Panel. Configure a comprehensive 6-panel research dashboard with the following end state:

- An active Synthetic EEG session
- A 6-panel display layout (the maximum number of simultaneous panels available)
- Each of the 6 panels assigned to a different widget type: Time Series, FFT Plot, Band Power, Accelerometer, Focus, and Head Plot
- Notch filter set to 60 Hz (US power line noise rejection)
- Expert Mode enabled
- A screenshot taken (using the 'm' key shortcut available in Expert Mode) to document the dashboard for lab records
- The full configuration saved to a settings file in ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Settings/

This dashboard must simultaneously display all relevant biosignal streams: raw EEG, frequency spectrum, band power, physical movement, cognitive state, and topographic scalp maps.

metadata.persona: Computational neuroscience graduate student / BCI researcher
